title: Make run files byte-identical across hosts
summary: Run files now carry a gzip header without the host's operating-system byte, and the run-file test compares the uncompressed data, so the shared fixture passes on Linux CI as it does on macOS.
next: Use the Runs page to look into the destination_v9 96-case failures.
